title: Support dialog
description: Help dialog that exposes the Studio support information.

ui.overview: The Support dialog provides help text without changing the scene. Use it when the user needs guidance or a support entry point while staying inside the Studio.

controls.label: Help content
controls.description: Shows the support information, links, or usage notes.

controls.label: Close
controls.description: Closes the dialog and returns to the workspace.

notes: This is a help surface, not an editing surface.
